descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的纸菜单记着两块大小不一的炸饼，都各有位置。
descriptions.en: My paper menu leaves room for both uneven pieces of fried bread.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使饭后自制纸菜单，把这一份土豆馅与薄边分开记下。
descriptions.en: My handmade menu records the potato filling and thin edge of this particular paratha.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在纸签上压出几道错开的短痕，记着通道里停住的队伍。
descriptions.en: Staggered little marks I pressed into a tab recall our halted group.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折出一段空白，记着风铃间互相等候的半句话。
descriptions.en: A blank fold in my card recalls a sentence waiting between the chimes.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我自己折的小列车，前端特意短一点，只纪念虚构领队游戏，不复制馆藏。
descriptions.en: My own paper train has a short front for our make-believe leader, without copying a museum vehicle.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使将自剪手形挪到纸边，中间空处留给别人看模型。
descriptions.en: I moved my own cut-paper hand to the edge to leave a clear view in the middle.
